evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or dedicated agenda question — the call opened around the customer's pre-flagged specialty item (a heavy safe) from the online form.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: The safe's weight/handling was the entire premise of the call — rep asked the exact weight, explained the 300lb ground-floor-to-ground-floor rule, and checked feasibility, scored full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we are time based... it all depends on how prepared you are' — partial 'estimate is a window' credit; no rate-lock/100k line, no explicit 'beats it, pay less' statement, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Handled the specialty-item (350lb safe) logistics carefully and specifically — checked the weight threshold, explained the ground-floor rule, and still closed the booking cleanly.
coaching_note: Closed with 'do you want to lock in a date?' but never used explicit rate-lock language ('your rate locks when you book') — worth adding to reinforce urgency at the moment of commitment.
